weather.title: Weather

reason.stale: No reading in the last {s} s (or the clock is before the first one): the station gives one per minute and it is missing here.

weather.age: Reading from {s} s ago (the station gives one per minute).

sessionRain.none: No reading with rain in the session.

weather.note: The circuit weather station (live timing). Not interpolated: the last reading and, if it is more than {s} s old, «no data». Rain is yes or no, with no intensity.
weather.windNote: The direction is relative to north, as the feed gives it (the dot on the compass). The 3D map is not north-up, so the wind is not drawn on it.
